findings.summary: Round 2 has no defined verdict: 'all three PASS' vs 're-dispatch only failing lenses' vs 'no verdict carries'
findings.suggestion: Restate as 'round PASS iff every lens dispatched THIS round returned PASS and merged blocking_issues/scenarios_missing are empty', or re-dispatch all three on retry.

findings.summary: Retry-round PASS undefined: passing lenses are not re-dispatched yet their verdicts must not carry, so three verdicts cannot exist in round 2
findings.suggestion: Scope the PASS rule to the lenses dispatched in the round.

findings.summary: A dead dispatch fails the round but names no repair action, so round 2 has nothing to rewrite and no lens qualifying for re-dispatch
findings.suggestion: Re-dispatch every lens that returned FAIL OR failed to return at all.

findings.summary: A dead/unparseable lens is excluded from retry because it never 'returned FAIL'; the round can loop with no action or pass with a lens omitted
findings.suggestion: Include non-returning lenses in the re-dispatch set.

findings.summary: The agent body's Hard Rules outrank the brief: an out-of-category defect is downgraded to a 'suggestion', the schema has no suggestions field, so it is discarded and does not move overall_assessment
findings.suggestion: Drop the downgrade rule or give each lens a legal category for off-list defects.

findings.summary: A lens that returned PASS while reporting out-of-lens blocking_issues is never re-verified after the resulting rewrite
findings.suggestion: Re-dispatch any lens whose findings drove a rewrite.

findings.summary: Dedupe on test_file:test_function:category collapses distinct defects that share a function and category but differ by line/title
findings.suggestion: Include line in the key; state which duplicate's title/reasoning survives.

findings.summary: Dedup key drops distinct issues and leaves the surviving line/title/reasoning undefined
findings.suggestion: Dedup on test_file:test_function:category:line and name the survivor.

findings.summary: 'in one message' — the concurrency the change exists to buy — is asserted nowhere; three separate fenced blocks with await-prose between them still pass
findings.suggestion: Require all three Task lines inside one fence with no intervening prose line.

findings.summary: No per-target positive control: _bodies() only asserts non-empty, so the codex artifact could stop carrying A.5 and every test still passes
findings.suggestion: Assert the three concrete paths, mirroring test_stage_agent_ledger_wiring.

findings.summary: The no-git regexes cannot match the codex Bash("... git ...") call form, so the rule is enforced on claude artifacts only
findings.suggestion: Add an alternative for the Bash("...") shape or detect fence membership.

findings.summary: A real git diff can re-enter the codex render and the no-git check still passes
findings.suggestion: Match the codex call form.

findings.summary: Lens ownership is pinned to the whole dispatch line, so three distinct labels with identical prompt bodies pass
findings.suggestion: Assert the lens appears in both the description= and the prompt segment of the same line.

findings.summary: The rewrite-conditioning check is a two-word vocabulary filter; 'Do not modify anything in passing_tests[]' evades it
findings.suggestion: Broaden the action class (rewrite|re-author|freeze|frozen|do not modify|touch|change).

findings.summary: The scenarios_missing handoff assertion is inert: the ordinary fix instruction already supplies that token
findings.suggestion: Require it in the same sentence as the handoff selector.

findings.summary: scenarios_missing checked by bare token presence over the whole retry region
findings.suggestion: Reuse the sentence-scoped handoff list.

findings.summary: The before/after handoff is checked by selector mention only; no content transfer is required
findings.suggestion: Tie the selector to acted-on blocking issues and require before/after.

findings.summary: The ledger guard was weakened, not re-pointed: expected is hard-coded to 1 for execute regardless of dispatch or round count
findings.suggestion: Derive expected from the number of fan-out blocks.

findings.summary: execute guard no longer scales with dispatch count and its substitute is a bare substring with no locus
findings.suggestion: Derive expected from fan-out blocks; require the phrase between the last dispatch and the emit line.

findings.summary: Raising aggregate_chars does not implement ADR-008; it grants a permanent 2130-char allowance that hides future real growth
findings.suggestion: Exclude instrumentation-gated text from the measurement instead of raising the frozen aggregate.

findings.summary: The agent body still declares passing_tests FROZEN while the merge table says it decides nothing
findings.suggestion: Restate the agent body line to match.

findings.summary: Communication Protocol still says 'the test-reviewer's reasoning' (singular) for a three-lens gate
findings.suggestion: Say the merged verdict is authoritative.

findings.summary: Ledger prose says --pass is the round number but the command literal still reads <attempt-number>
findings.suggestion: Replace with <round-number> in both arms.
